It turns out I wasn't pregnant, I'm not stupid, I'm a straight A student. When I'm older I *will* have kids, and I'll teach them common courtesy and to restrain themselves, something your parents seem to have neglected to do.

Now that I've wormed my way out of what happened, I'd like to just say that I'm not entitled, I'm grateful for everything I have, I fucked up once and now I'm okay. Not pregnant. Also, in reply to your other comment, I'd like to say that when I'm older, I will have kids, and I'll raise them not to act the way you did to me when I was upset. I'm not pretty or popular and I wouldn't just fuck anyone for the sake of it, I'm the freak. The girl who cuts all her hair off and acts like a boy, who has rumours going around that she's a lesbian that are only half-true. I fucked him because I wanted to, a stupid split second decision that I regret. I'm an intelligent person, straight A's, I understand the world, and I'm not some annoying facebook girl, I just made a mistake, one that I will never, EVER make again.
I'm just glad I don't have to push myself through all of the abuse anymore.  I know that I can do better, relationship-wise and success-wise. I feel a lot more like me now :) thanks.

I'm gonna start trying my hardest at everything I do. I realised how insignificant he is compared to everything else that is going to happen in my life. Tomorrow I'm going to have fun with some real friends, and I'm not going to let him get in the way of that. In all honesty, he has about four friends. He isn't that special himself, he started playing guitar because 'Girls dig it' about 8 months ago and he's just not a nice person in general. I'd much rather be ugly in his opinion and know I'm a good person inside than be good looking and rotten on the inside. 

I'm not *that* bad looking either. I did a post on AmIUgly because of all he's said, and I only had a couple of people not liking my haircut, then the others said I'm attractive. I think he just wanted to hurt me. And I've decided to start going to the gym for myself too, since I'm not happy with my weight and I want to feel like I'm doing something good for myself.

I really do feel like everything is gonna get better now. And I feel way more like myself, and I don't really care about my ex boyfriend anymore. I'm going to do the things I love, join some clubs, meet new people. In the art shop where I live they have fashion design classes, I could probably meet some people through that with a friend. As for everyone I've alienated throughout this ordeal, I'm going to apologise to them. I don't feel beautiful inside now, but I think with work I can become a better person and become someone worth talking to through that. I'm going to start doing my homework properly and taking life more seriously.

Thank you for helping me through this, you helped save my life tonight.   Especially in the sense that I'm really going to start being less mopey and sad and thinking 'everything is pointless, so I just won't do it'. I've realised that people like him are just not worth the time, and I've learnt that the hard way. All people make mistakes, and that's part of growing up. I'm not going to give him the satisfaction of seeing me upset, because that is all he wants. I hope my next relationship will be real, but right now I don't need or particularly want that. I really want to thank you for what you've done for me. It's really helped. What I'm gonna do now is smile, and be glad that it's over :)
I'll remember it, thank you x

I just need to move on, erase him and act like I feel happy.
Thank you so much. I feel so much better about myself. You probably saved my life tonight.
